Generated Narrative: CodeSystem suit-provisioning-status-cs

This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/suit-provisioning-status-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
pre-positioned Pre-positionedSuit pre-positioned at destination before crew arrival
in-transit In TransitSuit in transit to destination
deployed-primary Deployed - PrimarySuit deployed as primary EVA asset
deployed-backup Deployed - BackupSuit deployed as backup/contingency EVA asset
maintenance-required Maintenance RequiredSuit requires maintenance before next EVA
end-of-life End of LifeSuit has exceeded operational life limit
